citation.authors: Aloia JF, Talwar SA, Pollack S, Yeh J

record.population: 208 healthy Black postmenopausal American women aged 50-75
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 3 years, vitamin D3 at two doses with calcium given to all
record.finding: No significant difference in bone mineral density between vitamin D and placebo groups at any point; no relationship between blood level reached and bone loss. No significant adverse events were attributed to vitamin D.
